findings.summary: Requirement R3 (Markdown to HTML parsing) is scheduled for implementation in Milestone M3, but the audit trace expects completion within Milestones M1/M2.

evidence.note: Milestone M3 deliverables include the Markdown render plugin and per-note HTML generation (R3/R4), enabling R3.
evidence.quote: Markdown render plugin producing per-note HTML pages for all non-excluded notes (R3/R4).

evidence.note: Milestone M2 deliverables are limited to core engine, ingestion (R1), and skeleton emission (R2), with no content rendering component.

findings.summary: Acceptance Tests AT1, AT2, and AT3 are scheduled for automated execution in Milestone M3, extending beyond the trace check's expected scope of Milestones M1/M2.

evidence.note: Milestone M3 (Validate) includes the automated runs for AT1, AT2, AT3.
evidence.quote: Automated runs of AT1, AT2, AT3, AT4, AT5, AT6 integrated into CI for the core pipeline.
